data.name: Olin
data.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'ealan', meaning 'ruler, nobleman'. This name was popular during the Middle Ages and was often given to those of high social standing. In the Bible, there is a character named Olin who was a leader of the tribe of Issachar. He and his men were known for their understanding of the times and their ability to interpret signs and symbols.
